notes.title: Upgrades have been added
notes.notes: [p]I've added temporary upgrades:[/p][p][/p][p]Revolver Repeater - it fires two bullets with one trigger pull[/p][p][/p][p]Shotgun Spreader - it gives the shotgun a wider spread[/p][p][/p][p]Bulletproof Vest - the player is bulletproof [/p][p][/p][p]Speed Drink - this drink makes the player run faster[/p][p][/p][p]Super Dynamite - it gives the dynamite a wider damage area[/p]

notes.title: Difficulty levels added to game
notes.notes: [p]I've added a difficulty level system to the game: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Nightmare.[/p]

notes.title: Fixed some issues in the game/demo
notes.notes: [p]Issues fixed and changes made that were brought to my attention:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]enemies in the town level were seeing the player through walls, and they would all surround the player at once, causing slowdowns.[/p][/*][*][p]sometimes enemies would be moving much faster than they should have been, their speeds were fixed[/p][/*][*][p]the cursor was sometimes hard to see, so I made it bolder and a bit brighter[/p][/*][*][p]in ultrawide, the UI was off the screen, I fixed that, but I don't have access to an ultrawide monitor to test it[/p][/*][*][p]I moved the Tutorial button from the Options screen to the Main Menu screen[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Japanese language added to the game
notes.notes: [p]I've added Japanese to the language selection in both the game and the demo.[/p]

notes.title: New Levels
notes.notes:
I've added a new section where the player goes through caves to defeat outlaws. The hazards are that you can't throw dynamite over walls like in the desert levels. If you set off an explosion, it will cause a small cave-in, possibly blocking your path.
I've updated the demo with this level, which happens after the town level.

notes.title: New languages added to the game
notes.notes: I've added French, German, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese.

notes.title: Blood Country Update 1
notes.notes:
I'm adding more languages for the game. Right now I'm adding French, Italian, German, and Spanish. If anyone has a language they would like added, let me know.
I've also noticed that the tutorial in the demo wasn't loading, so I'm fixing that right now.
